result: SARAH/SPIDER-style recursive gradients plus a uniform perturbation when the gradient is small find (ε, δ)-second-order stationary points of finite sums with Õ(√n/ε² + √n/δ⁴ + n/δ³) stochastic gradients, almost matching the √n/ε² lower bound, with no negative-curvature subroutine.
result_plain: SSRGD: recursive gradient + occasional perturbation; near-optimal √n/ε² finite-sum rate for second-order points.
